body: 074 recorded as conditional test-planning specifications, not established purchase readiness. All 4 report and 7 source pins match, including admitted v10. T3-first is a proposed priority, not spending authority. T7 specifies R30 m (60 m diameter) production-sandwich shells; the historical $30–90k surrogate range explicitly does not cover them. No price, facility feasibility or smaller transferring article is established. T3 retains unresolved panel span/edge effects/wavelength; loading tolerances, metrology precision and quantitative acceptance criteria are not fully specified. Single cheapest articles do not establish scatter or a qualified allowable; 038 likewise calls three shells model discrimination, not qualification statistics. G1/G5 are intended test routes, not closed by specifications. The factor-1 return to 069 is conditional on Q=0.33 and other model assumptions; it does not restore physical float. The no-root-between-gamma-0.20-and-0.6407 wording applies only to the optimistic/common-weather target: the card itself gives ISA-only root 0.584519. 073 targets remain UNREVIEWED, use separate weather geometries, and keep the disclosed buckling-law and other input gaps. No new scientific computation, supplier contact or purchase. Current claim record stays admitted v10, unchanged by this filing. Audit: .ship/notes/mainline074-admission-check-1022.json.
